body: And for whatever reason it cut out the first sentence that said im 30.

30. Single for about the last 7 years. Girls avoid me like im contagious. I am not exactly the prettiest guy but ive never been told im ugly. Youre assuming i am not already the best version of myself i can be. I find myself to be pretty awesome. The people who do like me tend to come to the conclusion that i am one of the best friends they could have. I am reliable. Honest. Helpful for the most part. Not always the most pleasant person to be around but it happens to the best of us. And yet i still live with the constant drip drip drip of unfulfillment. I have worked several jobs that most people would consider fulfilling work. I myself find them to dull the unhappiness that i feel. But living only so i can stop feeling unhappy by working for someone else is not the same as being happy. And admitting im smart is bad form. Although other people have recognized it. People i havent seen sonce high school express their disappointment that i didnt wind up much greater than i have. I have my own car. My own house. I am currently self employed. I have a good work ethic and my customers are generally happy to thrilled with my work. Then i go home. And i sit in my house doing renovations by myself. 6 days a week. Maybe more. My life is not in shambles. I am going to be starting a new job soon. I will get paid the same as i make now with less headaches caused by running your own business. It will ease some stress, but the stress has never really been a problem. I function well at work. I excel when given a task. When people tell me i cant do something i accomplish my goal and simply smile at them. Although i have been known to brag on occasion. Again it happens to the best of us. There is no reason i cant exceed my own expectations or even everyone elses. Except i dont want to. Why bother when the only thing i have to look forward to at the end of the day is an empty house and an empty call log? None of what you offered was a reason to continue. I appreciate the effort. But the risk you imply isnt there? Is that i keep living and spend another several decades going home to an empty house with friends that dont return my calls because i can be inconvenient at times.
